notes: Initial ENMON release with installer/setup flow and core role separation.
Basic controller, matrix, reactor, display, and pocket node support.
Major TUI refresh for installer, config editor, and runtime panels.
Improved peripheral detection and post-install configuration editing.
Introduced controller-coordinated updater flow and shared version metadata.
Added node identity announcements, targeted update messaging, and rollout hardening.
Added installer and launcher log scrolling improvements.
Fixed the Basalt run-loop crash path in the config editor release.
Hardened raw fetches with cache-busting and canonical GitHub raw URLs.
Fixed controller HUD startup issues and updater fetch consistency.
Added force-update support for CLI and controller-driven rollouts.
Added terminal log hotkeys and controller monitor/view hotkey documentation.
Added controller terminal alert rotation and release helper tooling.
Moved maintenance/update commands into a dedicated enmon-cli.lua entrypoint.
Kept enmon.lua as the runtime launcher with compatibility forwarding for legacy CLI usage.
Refined runtime update UX and controller update presentation
Added runtime F2 config editing and installer/setup support for update-check interval
Hotfix missing lib/runtime_actions.lua in the release manifest
Restored normal updater recovery for nodes that received the broken 0.3.5 payload
